payload.text: Engine-handoff Cut codec (docs/CONVENTIONS.md Cut enum; engine state serialization): dec_cut is the pure total inverse of enc_cut over the Cut discriminant — decodes byte 0→Cut::NewYork1000, 1→Cut::Tokyo1500, and any other byte to Err(HandoffError::BadDiscriminant), never a silent default. No writes/allocation/IO; deterministic. Self-invalidates if the discriminant assignment or Cut variant set changes (WRITES gate).
